n: Georgia Tech STEAM Technical Theater Glowing LED Clock
t: A one-semester unit where students build a glowing LED clock prop for a play.
steps: Find the Georgia Tech STEAM lesson package for the Glowing LED Clock.
Gather micro:bits, LED buttons, and prop materials.
Arrange CNC access and a safe workshop space.
Test MakeCode and Vectr in a browser on student devices.
Build one sample button circuit before class.
Plan the schedule with the theater director.
